headlines.title: Supreme Court denies Trump’s mail-in voting restrictions
headlines.description: The Supreme Court rejected President Donald Trump’s attempt to restrict mail-in voting ahead of the midterm elections. NBC News’ Monica Alba explains the decision.

headlines.title: Trump calls Nvidia CEO to talk AI — and gets put on speakerphone during industry summit
headlines.description: “Data centers are great, and they make people wealthy,” the president told CEO Jensen Huang, whose company makes AI chips and hardware.

headlines.title: Mitch McConnell returns to Senate
headlines.description: Republican Senator Mitch McConnell returned to the senate after a three-month absence. NBC News’ Ryan Nobles reports.

headlines.title: Trump defends son over wedding party controversy
headlines.description: President Trump is defending his son Don, Jr. after a report suggested that a Russian man with links to Putin’s inner circle paid for a portion of his wedding party. NBC News’ Hallie Jackson reports.

headlines.title: EPA to repeal limits on greenhouse gas emissions from power plants
headlines.description: The move would overturn a 2024 Biden administration rule requiring power plants to control planet-warming pollution.

headlines.title: Pentagon inspector general says Iran war has led to a shortfall of U.S. munitions
headlines.description: It’s the first public report on the ongoing war started Feb. 28 by the U.S. and Israel.

headlines.title: Watch highlights of the 2026 Emmy Awards in 3 minutes
headlines.description: Apple TV's "Widow's Bay", "Pluribus," and HBO’s "The Pitt" received major awards at the 2026 Emmy Awards, with horror-comedy "Widow's Bay" taking home some of the night’s biggest awards, including outstanding comedy series, outstanding directing, outstanding lead actor Matthew Rhys, and outstanding supporting actress for Kate O’Flynn.

headlines.title: Emmys 2026 red carpet and winners: Matthew Rhys, Jean Smart, and more
headlines.description: On TV’s biggest night, the stars are coming out to shine.

headlines.title: The 2026 Emmys air tonight. Here’s what to expect, how to watch and who’s hosting.
headlines.description: Hollywood’s biggest night in television is back after a year of new beginnings. The 2026 Emmys will take place Monday, Sept. 14, at 8 p.m. ET.

headlines.title: Rapper Macklemore dropped from Ed Sheeran tour
headlines.description: Macklemore says he was removed from Ed Sheeran’s “Loop Tour” after his “Free Palestine” comments and messages on stage in recent performances. It’s a controversy that’s sparked criticism from singer Pink and NFL owner Robert Kraft. NBC News’ Liz Kreutz has the story.

headlines.title: Halloween Chocolatey Eyeballs Candy Recalled Over Allergy Risks
headlines.description: New Jersey candy company Little Temptations has recalled their popular “chocolatey eyeballs” because of undeclared milk allergens. The candy is sold at major retailers including Marshalls, TJ Maxx, and Home Goods in 13 states.

headlines.title: Bystanders chase down man accused of striking woman with stolen car on San Diego boardwalk
headlines.description: The 25-year-old woman was hospitalized in critical condition, officials said.
